# Mr Nor DnT - School of Design and Technology

Free-to-join browser multiplayer world (no login) for Mr Nor's D&T students. Walk around a pixel-art school, **chat in a public text chat room**, explore four D&T corners, talk to the D&T staff and play Decode Missions.

## What's in the world (`world.json`, generated by `tools/make_world.py`, 90 x 64 tiles)
- **D&T WORKSHOP** (top-left): Scroll Saw, Bench Drill, Sanding Machine (A = safety briefing: purpose, PPE, safe-use steps, then *Use the machine*: hold A / hold the button to run it with sawdust/swarf particles, then a safety question), safety-rules poster, workbenches. Technicians **Mr Rahim** and **Mr Salihin** stand here.
- **MATERIALS LAB** (top-right): hardwood, pine (softwood), plywood, MDF, aluminium, mild steel, acrylic, PVC - properties, resistance to water/rot/corrosion/heat/impact, uses + **Material ID Challenge** quiz.
- **JOINTS GALLERY** (bottom-left): butt, screwed, nailed, dowel, lap, cross halving, mitre, finger, dovetail, mortise & tenon, bridle, housing, biscuit, KD fittings - drawing, strength, description, uses + **Joint Quiz**.
- **FORMING & JIGS** (bottom-right): **Vacuum Forming Machine** (step-by-step animation: clamp, heat, raise mould, vacuum, cool, trim) + bending jig, strip heater/line bender, laminating former, sand mould, drape mould, template, drilling jig, cutting jig + **Forming Quiz**. **Mr Azmi** stands here.
- **Courtyard**: **Mr Nor Dnt** (main teacher NPC, paces; typewriter dialogue, D&T topics, tip of the day, quiz, Ask a question), **Mission Board**, **Notice Board** ("Study Hard for Your D&T", "Farewell Hillgrove", "Check my linktree channel" + *Open Linktree* button), **table with 2 computers** (*Open Mr Nor DnT website* - opens in a new tab; Google Sites refuses iframes, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`), **Mr Nor Dnt TV** (big screen; A opens a full-screen player using the youtube-nocookie embed, music pauses while it is open, *Watch on YouTube* fallback button). **Mr Huang** stands by the computers, **Mr Lau** by the notice board.
- No URLs are ever shown as text in the game; links open in a new tab (`noopener`).
- All learning text lives in `public/content.js` (edit it there). Panels: D-pad up/down to choose, A = select, B = close; large text, scrollable.

## Staff NPCs that answer questions (`public/npc-knowledge.json`)
Mr Rahim (workshop machines & safety), Mr Salihin (design for assembly, workshop), Mr Azmi (resistant materials, joints, forming/jigs/vacuum forming), Mr Huang (electronics, mechanisms, structures), Mr Lau (design process, sketching, CAD, 3D printing, ergonomics/anthropometry, sustainability, biomimicry), Mr Nor Dnt (all topics). Walk up, press A: topic menu -> tappable questions -> short answer, or **type a question**: matched in the browser (keyword + word overlap scoring, typo tolerant, the NPC's own topics boosted). Low score -> "Great question - ask Mr Nor!" (Mr Nor: "Good question - let's research it together in class!") plus 3 suggested questions. Typed questions pass the same rude-word filter and are **never sent** to the server or the public chat.
- The JSON is generated by `tools/make_knowledge.py` from a draft knowledge base kept outside the repo (written from Mr Nor's Drive lesson files). Topics with `"gen": true` (resistant materials, joints, forming, workshop machines) are general D&T knowledge - **Mr Nor should review them**.

## Public chat + safety
- Free text, max 140 characters, emojis allowed. Server cleans text (control/zero-width chars, extra spaces) and the client renders it as plain text only.
- Blocked server-side (`lib/chat.js`, also used in the browser as `/chatfilter.js`): rude words in English, Singlish and Malay incl. leetspeak/spaced letters, links/URLs, phone numbers, email addresses, a few rude emojis. Rate limit 1 message / 1.5 s (`CHAT_GAP_MS`), repeated message blocked for 30 s.
- Every chat line has a **⚑ Report** button -> logged on the server and shown on the teacher page.
- Teacher page (`/teacher`, PIN): **Pause chat**, reports, recent chat, players online with **Mute** (5 min-2 h) / **Kick** / **Ban** (by name + IP until the server restarts).
- Phones: tap **💬 Chat** (or press A away from any station) to open the keyboard with a text field, **Send** and **✖**. Speech bubbles above avatars for 5 s, scrollable chat log.

## Files
- `server.js` - Node (express + ws) server: name filter, chat filter + moderation, rate limits, movement validation, 100-player cap, heartbeat, teacher API. `TEST_TELEPORT=1` is for automated screenshots only - never set it on Render.
- `lib/chat.js` chat filter, `lib/missions.js` Decode Missions, `lib/phrases.js` phrase bank, `lib/sheets.js` Google Sheet sync, `apps-script/Code.gs`.
- `public/` - `index.html`, `game.js` (engine, renderer, stations, NPCs, TV), `content.js` (D&T content), `npc-knowledge.json`, `music.js`, `style.css`, `teacher.html`.
- `tools/make_world.py` (map), `tools/make_knowledge.py` (NPC Q&A), `tools/make_music.py` (background music).
- Tests: `node test.js [ws://host/ws]` (chat, safety filter, moderation, movement, missions, teacher API), `npm run test:sheets`, `python3 shot_revamp.py` (Playwright: phone/desktop/landscape - every station panel opens/closes, no overlap with the D-pad/A/B, TV, NPC dialogue + question matching, chat keyboard, no URL text, no page errors; needs a server started with `TEST_TELEPORT=1`).

## Decode Missions (communication game)
A pixel-art **MISSION BOARD** stands in the courtyard just south of spawn (`objects` in `world.json`).
1. Walk up to the board - a yellow **A: Mission** prompt appears (the A button shows 📋). Press **A** (Z on keyboard).
2. **Be the Sender**: the server picks a random secret phrase and shows it **only to you**. Explain it in the chat - **during your round the Sender may only send emojis** (server-enforced; use the phone's emoji keyboard). Everyone else chats normally. Your emoji messages also appear in the **Mission clue strip** for everyone.
3. Everyone else taps **🤔 GUESS** (strip, or the board) and picks 1 of **4 options** (correct + 3 distractors, shuffled each round). One guess each.
4. A round lasts **90 s**. When someone decodes it, the others get **5 s last chance**, then the round ends (or immediately once everyone has guessed).
5. Results pop up for everyone: who decoded it, the secret phrase, the Sender's emoji clues and how everyone voted - great for class discussion ("which emojis helped? which were confusing?").
- Scoring: first correct **+3**, other correct **+1**, Sender **+2** if anyone decodes it. Session leaderboard (top 5, by name) via the board or the 🏆 button. Scores reset when the server restarts.
- Panels work with the controller: D-pad up/down to choose, **A** = select, **B** = close (desktop: arrows/WASD, Z, X). Tapping also works.

### Teacher page - `/teacher`
Open `https://<your-site>/teacher` and enter the PIN (env var **`TEACHER_PIN`**, default **`1234`** - set your own on Render: Dashboard → service → Environment → add `TEACHER_PIN`).
- Start a round (random or chosen Sender, 60-180 s) / stop a round, reset scores.
- Add/remove your own phrases; choose **Mixed** (built-in + yours) or **My phrases only** (wrong options are borrowed from the built-in bank until you have 4+).
- **📺 Big screen** (or `/teacher?big=1`) for the projector: timer, clues, vote counts, results and leaderboard. The secret phrase is never shown on the big screen until the reveal.
- Custom phrases are saved to `data/custom-phrases.json` (or `$DATA_DIR`). **Render's free plan has an ephemeral disk**: the file is lost on every restart/redeploy (and when the free instance sleeps), so keep a copy of your list. Tunable env: `MISSION_SECONDS` (default 90), `MISSION_GRACE_MS` (default 5000).

### Google Sheet (optional): phrases, round log, all-time scores
Because Render's free disk is wiped on restart, phrases and results can live in a Google Sheet (**Emoji World Data**, tabs `Phrases`, `Rounds`, `Scores`, `ReadMe`).
1. Sheet → **Extensions → Apps Script** → paste `apps-script/Code.gs` → set `SECRET` to a long random string → Save → run `setup` once (allow permissions).
2. **Deploy → New deployment → Web app**, Execute as **Me**, Who has access **Anyone** → copy the `/exec` URL.
3. Render → Environment: `SHEETS_URL` = the `/exec` URL, `SHEETS_SECRET` = the same SECRET → **Manual Deploy**.
4. After editing Code.gs later: Deploy → Manage deployments → Edit → **New version** (URL stays the same).

When both env vars are set:
- On startup, every 5 min (`SHEETS_SYNC_MS`) and whenever the teacher page opens / presses **Sync**, active rows of `Phrases` (`active` TRUE or blank) become the custom phrase list (max 200).
- Teacher add/remove updates the game immediately and is written to the sheet in the background (remove sets `active` FALSE). Every finished round appends a `Rounds` row and adds points/rounds to `Scores`.
- Writes go into an in-memory queue that retries (`SHEETS_RETRY_MS`, 15 s timeout `SHEETS_TIMEOUT_MS`); if the sheet is down the game carries on and the teacher page shows a warning. Requests are `GET ?action=phrases|scores&secret=…` and `POST` `text/plain` JSON `{secret, action, …}`; redirects to googleusercontent.com are followed.
- Teacher page: Leaderboard gets an **All-time** tab (from `Scores`). The "Mixed / My phrases only" mode stays on the server.
- Without the env vars nothing changes (phrases saved to `data/custom-phrases.json` as before).

## Background music
**"Workshop Groove"** (`public/audio/workshop-groove.mp3`) - an original, upbeat chiptune loop (128 bpm, 30 s, 16 bars: square-wave melody, arpeggio, triangle bass, drums) synthesised from scratch by `tools/make_music.py` (numpy + ffmpeg, no samples, not based on any existing song), so there are no licence issues. Loops seamlessly via Web Audio at volume 0.2; starts after the JOIN tap, pauses while the tab is hidden and while the TV is open. Top-left: 🔊/🔇 mute (remembered in `localStorage` `ew_music_muted`). The old Spotify track/link has been removed.

## Controls
- Desktop: WASD / arrow keys move, **Z = A** (use / talk / open chat), **X = B** (close / wave), Enter or T = chat.
- Phone: Game Boy-style D-pad bottom-left, **A** = use the station you stand next to (prompt "A: ..." appears) or open chat, **B** = close / wave.

## Start / restart / stop
```bash
cd /workspace/emoji-world
./start.sh            # (re)starts server on :8080 + Cloudflare quick tunnel, prints public URL (logs/public_url.txt)
TUNNEL=0 ./start.sh   # server only
./stop.sh             # stop both
tail -f logs/server.log logs/tunnel.log
```
A quick-tunnel URL changes every time the tunnel restarts. Requires `cloudflared` (installed at `~/.local/bin/cloudflared`).

## Run on another computer (e.g. a Mac) to get a public link
```bash
# needs Node 20+ and cloudflared (brew install cloudflared)
npm install && node server.js            # http://localhost:8080
cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:8080   # prints https://xxxx.trycloudflare.com
```

## Deploy on Render (free)
This repo includes `render.yaml`. On render.com: sign in with GitHub → **New → Blueprint** → pick this repo → Apply
(or **New → Web Service**: build `npm install`, start `node server.js`, health check `/health`, plan Free).
Server listens on `$PORT` (default 8080) on `0.0.0.0`; websockets are on the same port at `/ws`.
Free instances sleep after ~15 min idle and take ~30-60s to wake; the client shows "Waking up server..." and auto-reconnects.
